items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL on ETR Sunday injury report; not expected to play per corroboration.
items.why: ETR comprehensive list; McVay/Schefter/Rapoport confirm doubtful/not expected, possible return next week vs Eagles.
items.implication: Adams elevated target/route share; Nacua sit this week.
items.opportunity: Adams high routes/targets without Nacua (prior 42% target rate on routes).

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday; Mariota starts. Positive longer-term news per Rapoport.
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin target share historically solid with Mariota but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: Monitor McLaurin/others under Mariota; Daniels not IR.

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Dobbins/Harvey handle backfield; reverse prior Coleman beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Committee but healthier duo lead; Coleman stale.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indy due to hamstring.
items.implication: Schultz/others elevated targets; Texans WR corps thinned.
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% route target rate and 28% target share last week without Collins; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) vs Bengals; Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder).
items.why: Official; toe injury. Coach: Warren will lead group.
items.implication: Warren lead back with checkdown upside vs vertical struggles for Rodgers.
items.opportunity: Warren lead snaps/carries + checkdowns; Homer/Heidenreich backups. Levitan projecting Warren in.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in as of now despite listings.
items.why: ETR internal proj based on practice/info.
items.implication: Start with confidence if no late change; monitor early news on Flowers/Moore.

items.text: ETR projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling proj at 44.0 (avg top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
items.implication: Elite upside play; smash spot potential.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; expect checkdowns spam as vertical pass game failing for Rodgers. Projecting Warren (Q) in. Backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach comments on lead role + rest; usage data opportunity.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with volume + receiving upside.
items.opportunity: Lead carries/snaps/checkdowns; high opportunity with teammate absence.

items.text: LOVE Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT/air yards; LV allows high YPR); LOVE Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share sans Collins; IND 4th-most TE yds).
items.why: Usage data + matchups; Collins out boosts Schultz.
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz elevated role/targets.

items.text: 10 Facts: Post-Stevenson fumble, Henderson 65% snaps/out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Brooks IR pushes Hubbard to firm lead (RB14 util), Dillon backup.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full takeover yet; Hubbard clear lead.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for both; handcuff/waiver relevant.

items.text: Davante Adams 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted 42%. Results prior misses: big games. Projecting with Nacua doubtful.
LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both games; RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.

HATE Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches; tough run D); HATE Travis Etienne vs LV (low snaps/touches even with Kamara); HATE Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest FPs to WRs, low YPR, low team total).
items.implication: Sit/fade; Henderson narrowed gap but Stevenson still ranked ahead by Berry.
items.opportunity: Henderson snaps post-fumble (65%, more touches); Hubbard lead with Brooks IR.
